recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-39117 unless FHIR-I later chooses to revisit the separate SHOULD-level ETag recommendation outside this issue's table-cell correction.
issue_request: FHIR-39117 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-I correction for the core HTTP page. The reporter noted that the interaction summary table made ETag look mandatory even though nearby guidance says servers SHOULD return an ETag; the approved resolution was to change "R:" to "O:" in the response table's Versioning column.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit e206a7d267627614f44423ae8aff20aa12f80505, corresponding to the Jira-linked PR 2615, which changed the affected source/http.html response summary Versioning cells from "R: ETag, Last-Modified" to "O: ETag, Last-Modified".
additional_context: publish.ini maps http.html to the built HTTP page, so source/http.html is in current build scope. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-14 record the same decision and 13-0-0 vote. Later same-page work, including FHIR-40496 capability-interaction clarification, did not reintroduce required ETag wording in the interaction summary. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related or conflicting decision that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current response summary table already marks ETag and Last-Modified as optional for read, vread, update, conditional update, patch, conditional patch, create, and conditional create, and a current source grep found no remaining "R: ETag" cell in source/http.html.

related_jiras.note: Later source/http.html capability-interaction clarification mentions ETag SHOULD guidance but did not change the FHIR-39117 interaction summary table cells back to required.
